headline: Russia Launches Massive Drone-Missile Barrage as Tu-160 Bombers Deploy from Belaya
subheadline: Ukrainian forces intercepted reactive UAVs over ten oblasts, with strikes hitting Kropyvnytskyi outskirts and Kyiv's Svyatoshynskyi district amid the overnight barrage.
lede: Russia launched over 150 jet-powered Shahed drones and dozens of missiles overnight, with Tu-160 bombers airborne from Belaya airbase, while Ukrainian air defenses engaged reactive UAVs across at least ten oblasts, hitting Kropyvnytskyi and Kyiv's Svyatoshynskyi district. In Gaza, Israeli forces demolished a 1.5‑kilometer tunnel in the north using the Northern Brigade and Division 99 engineering units. Meanwhile, Yemeni government forces seized Dhubab, Bab al-Mandeb and Mokha from the Houthis, a senior Houthi commander was killed in Bab al-Mandeb clashes, and Trump warned Iran of an imminent 'easy or hard' resolution.

sections.title: Russian Barrage Hits Ukrainian Cities and Infrastructure
sections.body: Russia launched over 150 jet-powered Shahed drones and dozens of missiles overnight, with Tu-160 strategic bombers airborne from Belaya airbase for possible cruise missile strikes. Ukrainian air defenses engaged reactive UAVs across at least ten oblasts, resulting in strikes on Kropyvnytskyi outskirts and Kyiv's Svyatoshynskyi district, while the Chonhar bridge linking occupied Crimea to Kherson collapsed. A Russian strike damaged the Dnipro River bridge in Zaporizhzhia, injuring five including two Red Cross workers, and a major fuel depot at Volodarskaya near Moscow burned, threatening supplies to Vnukovo, Domodedovo and Sheremetyevo airports.

sections.title: IDF Destroys Gaza Tunnel, Yemen Advances
sections.body: Israeli forces demolished a 1.5‑kilometer tunnel in northern Gaza using the Northern Brigade and Division 99 engineering units. Yemeni government forces seized Dhubab, Bab al-Mandeb and Mokha from the Houthis, while a senior Houthi commander, Abu Nasr al‑Shaif, was killed in Bab al‑Mandeb clashes. Trump warned Iran to decide between an 'easy or hard' resolution, Turkey announced a military deployment to Saudi Arabia to protect the East‑West oil pipeline, and Iran is constructing earth‑observation satellites with one‑meter imaging resolution.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The data shows a coordinated escalation with Russia employing long‑range aviation and drone swarms while Israel and Yemen engage in underground and coastal offensives, indicating a broadening of high‑intensity tactics across fronts. Simultaneously, regional actors are projecting power—Turkey mobilizing forces to Saudi oil infrastructure and Iran advancing satellite capabilities—suggesting preparations for prolonged strategic competition.
